title: CHG-4930: change to the Timesheet Service
body:
## Summary

This memo records a change to the Timesheet Service that is presently pending. The work affects 10
production servers behind the Timesheet Service and was submitted by Mateo Silva from Network Operations.

## Details

The implementation plan, drawn up with Bluegate Networks, spans these steps during the 22:00-23:30
UTC window:
- Rotate the database credentials used by the overnight batch jobs
- Replace the hand-maintained cron schedule with the workflow engine
- Archive documents older than seven years to cold storage

## Decision

As noted by the board, this change is an open request. Recorded by Grace Okafor on 27 October
2025; the board met on 22 April 2025 and the notes are in the shared archive.
